name: The White Tie Affair
description:
'''The White Tie Affair''' (also known as '''TWTA''') was an American [[pop rock]] band from [[Chicago]]. The group consisted of vocalist [[Chris Wallace (musician)|Chris Wallace]], guitarist Sean Patwell, drummer Tim McLaughlin, and keyboardist Ryan McLain. In early 2007, the band signed with [[Epic Records]]/Slightly Dangerous and released their debut studio album, ''[[Walk This Way (album)|Walk This Way]],'' in April 2008. The album contains three singles, "Allow Me to Introduce Myself... Mr. Right", "[[Candle (Sick and Tired)]]" and "The Letdown", which the first two have been featured on [[MTV]]'s ''[[Total Request Live|TRL]]'' and ''[[The Hills (TV series)|The Hills]]''. "Candle (Sick and Tired)" became the group's biggest hit to date, reaching number 57 on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]]. The group toured with [[Lady Gaga]], [[Metro Station (band)|Metro Station]] and [[Secondhand Serenade]], among many more, in support of the album.

The group planned on releasing their second album in the fall of 2010, with "You Look Better When I'm Drunk" being released as the lead single in April 2010. However, after they were dropped by their label, the album was scrapped and the group officially broke up in June 2012. Singer Chris Wallace embarked on a solo career shortly after, before the band briefly reunited in 2020, to release a previously unreleased song titled, "Seasons".
